items.caption: A modern redraw labeled 比 in Shang oracle-script style shows a compact, branching form. It is one proposed early-form example; the label does not establish what the sign depicts.
items.alt: Black branching glyph on a white background, labeled 比 in Shang oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows a labeled early-form example relevant to the disputed origin of 比, while avoiding treating a modern redraw as an excavated inscription or proof of its referent.

items.caption: A modern redraw of 比 in Shuowen seal-script style shows two tall, curved strokes with rounded tops. It illustrates a dictionary-form tradition, not an excavated seal inscription.
items.alt: Two tall, curved black strokes on a white background, representing 比 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Adds a visually distinct seal-script style example alongside the oracle-style redraw; it illustrates a labeled form without resolving the character’s disputed formation.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redraws. Their script-style labels identify the forms they represent, but they are not artifact photographs and do not establish whether 比 depicts people or derives from 匕-like signs.
